text:
sam: flagging a weird layout on foldables and narrow phones — when the console toolbar collapses to icons the table header loses alignment with the rows and the sticky toolbar overlaps the first row on scroll. repro on Pixel Fold in portrait. screenshot: https://img.redwood/fold-overlap.png
izzy: seen this too. looks like header uses position:sticky + transform on parent, which breaks stacking context on some browsers.
noor: quick hack: move sticky out of transformed parent or use position:fixed for the toolbar at small widths. downside: fixed needs safe-area padding for the fold hinge.
kevin: alternative: keep sticky but avoid transforms on the ancestor at <=420px. simpler CSS: remove transform:translateZ(0) around the table on narrow breakpoints. might fix stacking without changing the toolbar positioning.
maya: accessibility: when toolbar collapses to icons we must expose text via aria-labels and provide a toggle to expand toolbar for keyboard users. also ensure tooltips are accessible (long-press for touch).
sam: note on actions: when rows become condensed the overflow menu is the primary way to get secondary actions. let's make the overflow button the last tab stop but visible in the DOM order after primary action so keyboard reach is logical.
izzy: copy tweak: shorten "Expand details" -> "Details" in the toolbar and in row actions on small screens. avoids wrapping under the icon.
noor: UX nit for foldables: hinge area causes visual split where the table renders two halves slightly misaligned when the viewport width is narrow but height is large. propose switching to stacked card list for widths <600 when device reports 'fold' via CSS env or JS.
kevin: detection: use CSS env(safe-area-inset-left/right) or window.segmentedDisplay if available; fallback to width heuristics. when fold detected, switch to card layout and center content away from hinge.
maya: a11y checklist: announce layout switch? I think avoid surprise; instead preserve DOM order and only change visual layout via CSS where possible. ensure expanded details receive focus on open and that close returns focus to the triggering control.
sam: performance note: virtualized list + card switch can cause reflow thrashing. prefer CSS-only layout changes and lazy-mounting heavy details.
design-bot: preview deployed at https://staging.redwood/preview/foldable-toolbar-1876  includes: toolbar fixed on <420, card fallback for fold detection, aria-label updates.
izzy: plan: kevin will try removing transforms at narrow breakpoints, noor will prototype card fallback for foldable, maya will run the a11y checklist, sam will coordinate QA on Pixel Fold and iPhone 13 mini. aim to land in the sprint if no regressions. :shipit:
